content:
Count only rebate-qualifying invoices that have actually settled after execution under COMMIT. At 3,000,000 USD cents of qualifying settled principal, an approved rebate request credits 3,000 cents to the fee wallet.

Period remittance volume can include other tariffs and nonqualifying invoices; the rebate count does not. Activation charges and per-invoice charges remain posted even when the separate rebate is later claimed.
